rule.statement: A final judgment has a character of finality when it completely denies the rights of a party.
rule.supporting_quote: “ When this rule is applied to the facts of this case, it would appear that the order rejecting the alternative scheme of partition and plan while confirming the final partition scheme is an order which has a character of a final judgment because the rights of the 8th Defendant is completely denied by the said order.”
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 754(4) and 754(5) of the Civil Procedure Code
